body: I was originally struggling to symbolicate our 2nd most prevalent crash,. but have now managed. Its actually the same as Crash 1 and Crash 1b (for some reason, Google play grouped those 2 again as a separate crash), so I just added the data points I captured here and to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/112157

Crash on `AQUOS sense2 SH-01L` (Firebase Test Lab), API level 28, Vulkan 1.1.66, Adreno (TM) 506

It must be the same `DrawIndexed` crash.

`/vendor/lib64/hw/vulkan.msm8953.so (QglCommandBuffer::DrawIndexed(unsigned int, unsigned int, int, unsigned int, unsigned int)+220)`

Note: 

- This does not affect the `F-01L` (Firebase Test Lab) device. API level 27, Vulkan 1.0.61, Adreno (TM) 506. 
- On Firebase Test Lab, there's another arm32 device `Galaxy A02s` (Adreno 506), which hasn't been tested.
-  There's also an arm64 device `Galaxy Tab S3` (Adreno 530); the tests only run for a maximum of one minute, but the game doesn't load within that time. This device should also be affected by the crash.
